standard_prerequisites.name: Colimit cohomology
standard_prerequisites.use: Colimit commutation for f_* and R^i f_* on all modules.

core_obligations: The functors f_* and R^i f_* commute with direct sums and filtered colimits on all modules (cited colimit-cohomology lemma) (proof lines 2702-2704).
The factorization f_{QCoh,*} = Q o f_* and R^i f_{QCoh,*} = Q o R^i f_* with Q colimit-continuous (cited adjoint-kernel-parasitic (3)) yields the statement (proof lines 2705-2707).
proof_roadmap: Cite colimit commutation for ordinary pushforward.
Compose with the colimit-continuous Q through the framework factorization.
difficulty_reason: Two-step composition through the framework factorization f_{QCoh,*} = Q o f_* and R^i f_{QCoh,*} = Q o R^i f_*: the ordinary pushforward functors commute with direct sums and filtered colimits by the colimit-cohomology lemma, and Q commutes with all colimits by the adjoint-kernel-parasitic lemma.
